name: 83316 · Buhl, ID
findings: ZIP 83316 (Buhl) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83316 (Buhl) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
